criteria.evidence: Replay's turn-0 review listed 3 findings (platform read guard, `exports` shadowing, research.md drift), all fixed in the diff; two further items flagged with reasons for leaving them.
read() now throws `has an empty value at '${path}'` when `typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === ''`.
readPlatformVersions throws `has an empty list at 'android.platforms'` when `platforms.length === 0`.
Non-array throws `has a non-list value at 'android.platforms'`; entries read via read(`android.platforms.${index}.version`) so a missing version fails with the path named.

Diff removes the action's top-level `outputs:` block (imageid/digest/metadata) and `id: build`, but the redundant `outputs` input (`description: 'Buildx --output value...'`) is untouched and build.yml's fork leg still passes `outputs: type=docker`; no switch to `load: true`.
Replay never examined `outputs: type=docker` vs `load: true`; it verified a different claim (that imageid/digest/metadata are unused).
Turn 1 reply: 'The systemic issue' section with schema-vs-emitter table, job graph evidence (`validate-version-files` sibling of `build-image`, no `needs:` edge), and quoted design-doc claims.

Turn 1 recommendation (schema gates the builds, shared across callers) implemented via new validate-version-manifest action + validate-manifest.yml wired into all seven consumers; residual items (unit test, JS lint) reported as not done with reasons.
Replay reported gx not installed and verified YAML parses, but never ran or mentioned prettier; new research.md table columns are unaligned, which prettier would reformat.
Turn 3: 'Committed in four units on `refactor/shared-linux-image-build-action`; working tree is clean.'
Turn 3: 'I could not push: this repository has no remote configured' with instructions to add remote and push.

judge.reason: The script hardening, systemic analysis, manifest gating and local commits all meet their criteria, but finding 4 was misidentified: the replay removed the composite action's declared outputs block instead of the redundant `outputs` input, leaving build.yml still passing `outputs: type=docker` and never verifying equivalence with `load: true`. Prettier formatting was also not run or addressed.
